howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在每次会话开始和用户提交提示时自动注入项目规则，并在修改文件后自动补充匹配的文件特定规则。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、项目规则、规则文件位置、匹配规则或环境配置时触发。

say.text: 帮我查看当前项目有哪些规则文件？
say.note: Claude 会列出已识别的规则源。

say.text: 如何添加一条规则到我的项目？
say.note: Claude 会解释规则文件的存放位置和格式。

say.text: 禁用规则功能，设置环境变量。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude automatically injects static project instructions at session start and user prompt submit, and injects matching file-specific rules after apply_patch. Dynamic PostToolUse output is added as context without rewriting tool output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: Show me the rule files in this project.
How do I add a rule to my project?
say_en.note: Claude explains rule file location and format.

say_en.text: Disable rules by setting an environment variable.
